Best beer
Oct 2019
We love our craft beers, so were delighted to discover the craft beer scene in Vietnam. Of all the bars we visited, Lac would be our favourite. Possibly a smaller selection of beers than some of the other bars we visited, but definitely of a better quality. Craft beers are always more expensive than the more generic variety, but they were no more expensive here than at any other craft bar. It was my Husband's favourite - snacks were very good as well. The manager was extremely friendly and made us welcome. Worth more than one visit!

Pretty good beer brewery
Sep 2019 • Solo
I walked past this place and thought I would give it a try. The venue wasn’t very busy and I was seated at the bar and promptly served. Compared to a lot of other craft beer places in HCMC I think the beer menu was a little small and a few of the beers were not available. I opted for one and it was mostly enjoyable although I did not stay for another. The food menu did look good although I thought it may have been a bit expensive for the venue so I passed. The owner I believe was serving beers and was seemed very chatty with a couple that was in the venue. He sounded very enthusiastic for his work! In comparison to the brewery across the road which was quite a large establishment I believe this place was on par price wise with a smaller choice of beers. It was a quirky bar and had interesting beers so worth a visit, I just couldn’t imagine spending a whole evening here.

Beware they've moved. But the beer is apparently still awesome
Jun 2018 • Business
I'm not a beer drinker but my friends all loved it. They ordered flights of 4 different craft beers and we literally ordered one of everything on the bar menu. I had an entree of the fish and chips and technically what they serve aren't chips, but as an American I can honestly say not even my grandmother fries a better potato. Soft and fluffy on the inside and crispy on the outside. This place used to be across from SSIS but is now next door to VIVO city. It's a chill vibe, with excellent food and good service. It doesn't have that obnoxious EDM or sticky floors like the beer clubs in PMH. You can have a beer, have a snack and a conversation. We had fish and chips, 3 different kinds of sate, fried spring rolls, a charcuterie platter and it was all delicious.

Offering very tasty beers and snakcs but quite expensive compared to others.
May 2017 • Couples
I visited Lac Brewing Company on three separate occasions and first I must confirm that the beer is excellent, as are the bar snacks which include really tasty pizza and other nibbles. The staff are polite and the pub is located in a nice part of distict 7 on the 1st floor (above ground floor) so is a little hard to find. I have two minor points of feedback I would like to offer whilst wanting to really celebrate and promote another craft beer place in Saigon. Firstly, (at least on the 3 occasions I went), there is no option to order a proper pint sized glass of beer which seems very odd indeed. Only medium size glasses and at pretty steep prices considering this is outside of the centre. At time of my visit their 'medium' sized craft beers were about 20% more expensive then even district 1 places. Also (and my biggest concern) is the short serving of beers by pouring heads (the foamy part of the beer) which are clearly too big. I know this is not the UK (where the law stipulates that no more than 5% of the beer may be head/foam) but on two of the occasions I visited the head was approaching 20% of the glass- not good. For an already pricey drink we should get a full pour. The head of a good craft beer (should be maximum 10% at the absolute outside and preferably the UK stipulated 5% though I have seen closer to 10% in other craft beer places in Vietnam and the US so I guess that's fair.). So, again I applaud the beer itself and the food and the friendliness of the service and would return but short serving customers and expecting them to pay over the odds for a pretty small glass of beer is not going to win any long term supporters with district 7 regulars. As the area is a suburb there is no steady stream of tourists to count on either. I hope Lac can fix this and go on to thrive with their business.
